core.notes:
New Profile data window (Profile Sync › View data, or "Profile data" in the menu): every synced section as a tile with its values, how fresh it is, how it is kept and what uses it, with search, filters and a Raw view
Appearance › Layout › Top bar › Sync dot: turn off the dot on the Profile Sync icon
Modules and tools that not every player has are named in light blue in the menu and the Control Panel, with a small TRUSTED mark in their window (dev-only ones in the dev colour); Modules › Info explains the colours
Notifications are easier to see: bigger (110%), 8 seconds instead of 6, and framed in their colour; Control Panel › General › Notifications sets where they appear (any corner, top centre, or beside the menu), how long they stay (up to "until closed"), their size and style
Checking for updates from the menu now says "Checking for updates…" and turns into the answer
Cost Tables: the partner hiring cost now comes from the same game data as Party's Shop (same numbers)
Dungeon Win Rate: Now tells AWOO+ who it is for, which AWOO+ uses to colour the names of modules not every player has
Sculpture Grid Labels: Now tells AWOO+ who it is for, which AWOO+ uses to colour the names of modules not every player has
